name: N.T. Christian Farm
tagline: Link to N.T. Christian Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/NTChristianFarm
description: N.T. Christian Farm is a independent farm in 249 County Road 68 East, AL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
